title: Waymo Quintuples Robotaxi Fleet Goal to 20K Vehicles by 2027

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A $5 billion debt issuance this month provided the capital for a new growth phase at Alphabet's autonomous taxi unit. Waymo plans to increase its fleet from 4,000 cars today to 8,000 by the end of 2026 and reach 20,000 vehicles by the close of 2027, according to reporting from Semafor citing internal sources.

The expanded network would enable 1 million weekly rides by year-end based on the current average of 125 paid trips per vehicle per week. Reaching the 20,000 vehicle target by 2027 would represent a fivefold increase in Waymo's current operational capacity.
